pipelines.title: Core Pipelines Module
pipelines.description: This module provides foundational and specialized pipeline classes for common NLP and multimodal tasks, including automatic speech recognition, document question answering, and image-text-to-text generation. It leverages a chunking mechanism for efficient processing of large inputs.
